snippet.title: Trailer - Pizza At Resort 64
snippet.description:
Welcome to your temporary vacation job. 🍕
Seven days working as a pizza chef at a tropical resort.
Simple tasks. Perfect routine.
But something feels… off.

Pizza At Resort 64 is a short, atmospheric first-person experience about routine, seasonal work, and the quiet discomfort of places that feel too perfect to be real.

📅 Releasing January 2026
🎮 Steam Coming Soon page available
store.steampowered.com/app/3926030/Pizza_at_Resort_64/

Some vacations don’t end the way you expect.
